name: manage_project_memory
description: List, search, record, update, archive, or delete memories for the active Project. Use this for durable project-scoped decisions, style rules, domain facts, constraints, and standing tasks. Requires the current conversation to belong to a Project.

id.description: Project memory id for update, archive, or delete.

kind.description: Memory kind for record or update.

title.description: Short title for record or update.

pinned.description: Whether this memory should be favored during prompt injection.

confidence.description: Confidence that this memory is current and useful.

expiresAt.description: Optional expiry datetime for temporary project memories.

conflictStatus.description: Conflict lifecycle status for the memory.
